hook: Your satellite map of Dubai shows an island shaped like a palm tree.
title: Dubai's Palm Tree Island Is Made of Sand
description:
Palm Jumeirah in Dubai is a real island shaped like a palm tree. It did not exist naturally. It was built by piling sand into the sea, and you can see it from space.

#Shorts #Dubai #Geography
comment_prompt: Would you live on it? Yes or no
